description: Source code for the PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) scheduler in a 5G NR (New Radio) system, implementing PRACH configuration, slot allocation, and occasion management.

classes.name: prach_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling PRACH opportunities, managing occasions, and resource allocation in a 5G NR system.

methods.name: prach_scheduler::prach_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing PRACH configuration, slot and occasion parameters based on cell configuration.

methods.name: prach_scheduler::run_slot
methods.description: Pre-allocates PRACH PDUs for a given slot, handling initial setup and ongoing scheduling.

methods.name: prach_scheduler::stop
methods.description: Resets the scheduler to initial state.

methods.name: prach_scheduler::allocate_slot_prach_pdus
methods.description: Allocates PRACH resource blocks and symbols within a slot, based on configuration and occasion validity.
